name: Amax Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Amax Holding Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of sophisticated server hardware solutions for businesses. Their portfolio of offerings encompasses cutting-edge high-performance computing platforms for artificial intelligence, compact yet powerful high-density servers and storage units, and advanced liquid cooling systems for server cabinets. Established in 1984, the company's main operations are directed from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
